questions.de: Auf welchem Kontinent leben mehr als 50 Prozent aller Kaninchen der Erde?
questions.en: On which continent do more than 50 percent of all the world's rabbits live?

timeline.labelEn: The cottontail genus Sylvilagus, North America's wild rabbits, named by John Edward Gray
timeline.labelDe: Die Baumwollschwanzkaninchen (Gattung Sylvilagus), Nordamerikas Wildkaninchen, von John Edward Gray benannt

questions.notes: A widely repeated trivia claim ("more than half of the world's rabbit population lives in North America"), found on the Baku Zoo page and copied encyclopedia text; no primary population count backs it. Timeline: cottontail genus authority Gray, 1867 (en.wikipedia Cottontail rabbit).
